dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (JMA standard receipt software), running on Linux, developed by NACL. Uses GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL conventions typical of the ORCA project.
evidence: COPY count 37, CALL count 63 typical of ORCA subprograms
No EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance billing (receipt/claim calculation) - specifically inpatient fee (Nyuinryo) calculation subprogram for the JMA ORCA standard receipt software system
purpose.summary: This is a subprogram (ORCSNYUFTN) within the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system that calculates inpatient fees and patient co-payment amounts for Japanese health insurance billing. It handles complex Japanese medical insurance rules including various insurance combinations, elderly patient calculations, disaster/emergency cases, and regional public expense calculations. The program has an extensive revision history spanning 2002-2012.

notable_features: Large OCCURS tables for daily inpatient fee tracking
37 COPY statements indicating heavy use of shared copybooks
63 CALL statements to other ORCA subprograms
412 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
Revision history spanning 02/10/29 to 12/09/18 with 80+ revisions
Regional public expense (Chihou Kouhi) support for multiple Japanese prefectures
verdict.notes: File is encoded in latin-1 but contains Japanese EUC-JP text in comments (mojibake visible in the truncated source). The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system for Linux. Source truncated at 16000 chars out of 371651 bytes (7606 lines total), so only the header comments and early DATA DIVISION working storage are visible, but the program identity and purpose are unambiguous.
